symptom: ako/mxcli#2128 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1809): `mxcli diff -f struct` of an unchanged snippet's describe output reported it modified, and exec rewrote it. On TestApp 4 of 89 snippets: three text boxes' ScreenReaderLabel, and Snip_WorkflowActivityRecord_Details' visibility Conditions (25 -> 17 items).
cause: Two values MDL cannot state. (1) Studio Pro stores an unset screen-reader label as a ClientTemplate whose one translation has empty text; CarryUnexpressed only recognised a template with no translations. (2) An attribute visibility over System.WorkflowActivityType stores a condition per value of the 11.14 enumeration; mxcli's System metadata lists 16 of 24 values, so the rebuild wrote 17 conditions and dropped 8. The issue's trailing-newline expression was already carried (#1897).
insight: Run the reporter's loop (describe -> diff -f struct per snippet) on TestApp before reading the report's own examples: it found the second cause, which the report filed under 'rewritten'. Carrying a stored condition list that is a strict superset with identical flags is version-independent, unlike extending the System enum table, which needs per-version measurement. Verified: all four snippets Unchanged after.
